environment: Dedicated rooted Android API34 emulator; actual signed APK host via adb forwarding; synthetic HEIC/MOV bytes; not physical iPhone, Photos, Shortcuts, Wi-Fi, or personal media

tests.name: actual dedicated Android APK matches the frozen release
upload sender and receiving peer authenticate independently
authentication, Origin and method rejection create no file tasks
Content-Length original HEIC returns one final completed receipt
independent C receives unchanged HEIC source bytes
HEIC remains private temporary relay without automatic Downloads publication
chunked original MOV returns one final completed receipt
independent C receives unchanged MOV source bytes
MOV remains private temporary relay without automatic Downloads publication
Content-Length interrupted body removes its task, prefix, metadata and share
chunked interrupted body removes its task, prefix, metadata and share
malformed chunk framing fails without retaining an upload
chunked framing remains forbidden on the ordinary native upload endpoint
sender session revocation preserves C download and exact-key deletion removes only own temporary data
pre-existing saved ledger and readable Downloads bytes remain unchanged
